issue_context.title: Feature: Add Storage Sense option  when right clicking drives
issue_context.body:
### What's the Problem?

_No response_

### Solution/Idea

File Explorer has an option to open the Disk Cleanup tool when you view the properties of a fixed drive. It'd be nice to have that option in the Files app.

### Requirements
- Add storage sense option when right clicking drives
- Apply this change to the sidebar, layouts, and drives widget

### Files Version

2.0.34.0

### Windows Version

10.0.22499.1010

### Additional comment

_No response_
comments: Thank you for your feedback, this is on our todo list and is being tracked in #14683.

review_comments: Can you put this after properties?
Properties shouldn't be always on the bottom??
Anything specific to drives should be under properties, this way it's consistent with the Quick Access widget.

I don't understand what you mean.

Quick Access widget card item right clicked in Files
![image](https://github.com/files-community/Files/assets/62196528/bb36dc3f-376d-4517-9c6d-fb7984b42f8b)

Drives section right clicked in File Explorer
![image](https://github.com/files-community/Files/assets/62196528/5addd092-7536-4265-9d35-11ecde48302c)
I'm not sure why File Explorer is like that

> this way it's consistent with the Quick Access widget.

I don't understand. Items only shown for Quick Access are none.

> I'm not sure why File Explorer is like that

I assume it's because Microsoft has always implemeneted as below.

![image](https://github.com/files-community/Files/assets/62196528/44483de9-00d7-48af-ad9d-920b65916d48)

> it's consistent with the Quick Access widget.

I don't understand; Quick Access widget specific items don't exist. Can you clarify what you mean?

> Can you put this after properties?

In my opinion I don't want to do so because it is always displayed on a context flyout of any item and should be on a specific place from UX aspects. Idk @mdtauk says but I don't without clear reason why.
Items that are the same across all widgets should always be in the same position, this helps with muscle memory and improves the consistency throughout Files.
Being at the bottom of couse helps with muscle memory. I can say definitely tho. This is the same as Copy, Paste, etc those on primary context.

I should have talk about this before work on this PR. I think I will add support to run RichCommand from widgets and sidebar and so in the mean time this work will be wasted/removed.

Could I close and discuss in the issue?
